CONSTRAINTS: (a) only PA and CD may be alphanumeric; TI, CC, SC, RC, CE, PE and PT must be all digits (PT up to 8); (b) a PE (PEP) number must be EXACTLY 15 digits (SOI hard rule) and PE may not be used for health contribution periods from September 2023 onwards (AT2 v30 p.81); (c) where the Foreign National Not Liable to Pension flag is set only CE, PA, CD, SC, PE and PT are valid; (d) the Colombian Abroad flag may be used only with CC or TI; (e) NI is an EMPLOYER document type and is NOT valid for a contributor; (f) for a legal representative only CC, CE, PA and CD are available - see 'Legal Representative Document Type'. cells.old: Part-time worker under the special partial-time contribution regime of Law 2466 of 2025 art. 34. Uses the hours-worked field instead of the one-minimum-wage base floor.
cells.new: Part-time worker under the special partial-time contribution regime of Law 2466 of 2025 art. 34. On PILA it contributes to pensions, occupational risk and the family compensation fund only (no health). The pension and CCF contribution base follows the days worked in the month: 1-7 days one quarter, 8-14 days two quarters, 15-21 days three quarters, 22-30 days one minimum monthly wage; occupational risk is always 30 days on one minimum monthly wage (AT2 v30 p.117). Entry and withdrawal events are mandatory (p.118). The hours-worked field is not the contribution base.
Dependiente con permanencia en el Régimen Subsidiado

Employee who starts an employment relationship while belonging to the extreme-poverty, moderate-poverty or vulnerability population and chooses to stay affiliated to the subsidised health regime (Law 2466 of 2025 art. 65; Resolution 611 of 2026). PILA only. Contributes to health, pensions, occupational risk, family compensation fund, SENA and ICBF; the base is the monthly salary, never below one minimum monthly wage, proportional to the days worked for health, pensions and occupational risk. The health administrator code is MIN005 (ADRES).

Pairs with the Subsidised-Regime Permanence Flag (Country Fields). The operator validates the employer and the employee against the ADRES file "Reporte de información de afiliados con permanencia en el régimen subsidiado" for the contribution period; the employee names must match that file, and if either is not listed the type cannot be used (AT2 v30 pp.132-133).

cells.old: General sickness absence. The employer bears days 1-2 (Decree 780 of 2016 art. 3.2.1.10); the health insurer funds from day 3.
cells.new: General sickness absence. The employer bears days 1-2 (Decree 780 of 2016 art. 3.2.1.10); the health insurer funds from day 3. On the PILA the field takes blank, X or L: L = childcare leave (licencia para el cuidado de la niñez, Decree 780 of 2016 art. 2.2.3.2.12 as replaced by Decree 2126 of 2023), with no occupational-risk contribution (AT2 v30 p.88, field 25).
